schemes.name: Node CAFE (Multi-Sensor LPP)
schemes.description: Decodes Node CAFE 39-byte payloads: [0..1]=CAFE, [2..5]=Serial 96B840EB, [6..]=Cayenne LPP (Battery, Accel, Temp, GPS, DigIn)

schemes.name: Standard 2-Byte Node ID + TLV / IPSO Channels
schemes.description: Decodes 2-Byte Node ID (0..1) + Header + dynamic TLV / Cayenne LPP sensor channels (Temp, Batt, Hum, Accel, GPS, Switch)

schemes.name: Sensor Node AA0B (Temp / Volt / Seq)
schemes.description: Matches incoming payloads starting with AA0B header

schemes.name: Sensor Node AA0C (Telemetry / Battery)
schemes.description: Matches incoming payloads starting with AA0C header

schemes.name: ASCII Text & Test Pings
schemes.matchCondition:
if (bytes.length < 2) return false;
return bytes.every(function(b) { return (b >= 32 && b <= 126) || b === 10 || b === 13; });

schemes.name: Cayenne LPP Standard Sensors
schemes.description: Decodes standard IPSO/Cayenne LPP sensors (temp, hum, analog, accel, GPS)
